blocks.task_summary: Find the least integer n for X ~ B(n, 0.25) such that P(X ≥ 1) > 0.99, using complement rule P(X ≥ 1) = 1 − (0.75)^n and solving the exponential inequality.
accepted_alternatives: GDC binomial CDF table: compute P(X ≥ 1) for n = 16 (≈0.98998 < 0.99) and n = 17 (≈0.99248 > 0.99), conclude n = 17

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: correct inequality or equation involving P(X = 0) (A1); attempts to solve inequality involving 0.75^n for n (M1); 1 − 0.75^n > 0.99 OR 0.75^n < 0.01; n > 16.0078... (A2); least value n = 17 A1

METHOD 2: attempts binomial cdf for one value of n (M1); correct P(X ≥ 1) values (A1); P(X ≥ 1) = 0.989977... < 0.99 for n = 16 (A1); P(X ≥ 1) = 0.992483... > 0.99 for n = 17 (A1); least value n = 17 A1
